_provenance.dataQuality: SEED ESTIMATES. Trust-level anchors are researched from published reporting (see sources); the TFC-level split and operational parameters are ESTIMATES pending ingest of the published NHSE provider extracts (RTT incomplete-pathways-by-TFC, DM01, cancer waits) — see README for the ingest path.

rttPct18.note: reported 55.1% (Jan-26) -> 63.5% (Mar-26); model seeded at weighted 63.4% for Jul-26 start
rttPct18.source: West Bridgford Wire / NUH board reporting

waitingList.note: ESTIMATE — NUH incomplete pathways of this order; replace with NHSE published figure
waitingList.source: estimate from trust scale (one of England's largest acute teaching trusts, 2.5m local + 3-4m tertiary catchment)

cancer62d.note: 62-day performance ~66% vs 70% national ambition; backlog peaked >650 (Oct-25), 555 by mid-Nov-25; constrained pathways: breast, gynaecology, urology, lower GI
cancer62d.source: West Bridgford Wire; Chad; Newark Advertiser

cancerFDS.note: FDS 64.8% vs 70.9% trust trajectory and 80% national objective

edFourHour.note: ESTIMATE ~50% (headline: 'half of A&E arrivals seen within four hours'); median wait 2h59m Mar-26; planning objective 82%

levers.sourceNote: current values are typical-acute ESTIMATES; targets from GIRFT / NHS Elect / planning guidance
